main_body: steel column with capital, ribbed shaft, and base
top_band: light grey horizontal surface on top of the capital at rows 9-11, followed by a lighter front edge at row 12
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 8 is the top outline, rows 9-11 are the flat light-grey top surface of the capital (with a top-left specular highlight at row 9), row 12 is a brighter front-edge highlight line, row 13 is the vertical front lip of the capital with rivets, rows 14-16 are the dark eave/underside shadow below the overhanging capital, rows 17-39 are the vertical fluted shaft with horizontal rings, and rows 40-47 form the base (which also shows a 2-row top shelf at rows 41-42 and front edge at row 43). Both top band (4 rows) and front face (35 rows) are clearly constructed.

style.evidence: The steel ramp has 5 distinct grey steps (bright highlight, light grey, mid grey, dark grey, very dark grey) plus a uniform pure/near-black outline (#0f1217) around the entire silhouette. Unlike the Beodeul references which use selective dark material tones for outlines and rich per-tile surface speckle, the column relies on a heavy black border and clean geometric banding, making it look slightly more 'sticker-like' and lower in texture density than the reference props.
